answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by forcing every identity to maintain a unique yarrow computation bond that is continuously re-proven against live external oracles. The bond reaches its zenith only after successive original contributions are attested, while any identity that sinks to the nadir of repeated low-effort or duplicated work has its entire locked stake forfeited. Because the proofs cannot be shared or bulk-generated across identities without detection, an attacker must multiply both capital and genuine computation for each additional fake head.
